_comment: Pose changes for the instruction edit mode, one per expression, for visual novel and chatbot sprites. Each one is a small gesture that starts from the character's current pose: the stance, body angle and framing stay, only the arms, hands, shoulders and head move. The outfit clause is always added, because the edit model otherwise adds, removes or changes clothing when the arms move. The gestures follow a hand-drawn reference sprite set; hands stay off the face so face inpainting still finds it afterwards.
prefix: Change the facial expression and the pose.
keep: Keep the same stance, body position and camera framing; only move the arms, hands, shoulders and head as described.
outfit: Keep the outfit exactly as it is: do not add, remove or change any clothing or accessories, and keep the same amount of skin showing.
suffix: Keep the same character, face, body proportions, art style, colors, hair and background.
photo_suffix: Keep the same person, body, hair and background. Keep it a realistic photo with natural skin color.

poses.admiration: One hand is raised loosely beside the cheek, fingers lightly curled.
poses.amusement: One hand is raised to cover the mouth, as if holding back a laugh.
poses.anger: Both hands are on the hips and the upper body leans slightly forward.
poses.annoyance: One hand is on the hip and the head is turned slightly away.
poses.approval: One hand gives a thumbs up at chest height.
poses.caring: One hand rests gently over the heart.
poses.confusion: The head is tilted to one side and one finger scratches the cheek.
poses.curiosity: The upper body leans slightly forward and the hands are held behind the back.
poses.desire: The hands are held behind the back and the head tilts slightly.
poses.disappointment: The shoulders slump, the head hangs slightly down and the hands are held behind the back.
poses.disapproval: The arms are crossed over the chest and the head is turned slightly away.
poses.disgust: The body leans back slightly and both hands are raised in front of the chest, fingers curled, as if warding something off.
poses.embarrassment: Both hands are raised close in front of the chin, fingertips together, and the shoulders draw in.
poses.excitement: Both hands are raised beside the shoulders with the fingers spread.
poses.fear: Both hands are raised up near the face, pulled in close to the body.
poses.gratitude: Both hands are pressed together in front of the chest.
poses.grief: Both hands are clutched together against the chest and the shoulders draw in.
poses.joy: One hand is raised beside the cheek, palm open.
poses.love: The upper body leans slightly forward and both hands are raised to the cheeks, the chin resting on them.
poses.nervousness: The hands are clasped together in front of the body and the shoulders are raised.
poses.neutral: The arms rest relaxed at the sides.
poses.optimism: Both hands are raised at shoulder height, palms open, in a cheerful wave.
poses.pride: Both hands make a V sign at shoulder height.
poses.realization: One finger is raised in the air, as if saying 'I've got it'.
poses.relief: One hand is placed on the chest, as if letting out a sigh.
poses.remorse: The head is lowered and the hands are clasped in front of the body.
poses.sadness: The head is lowered, the body turns slightly away and one hand holds the collar.
poses.surprise: Both hands are raised up near the chest, palms open.
